TANNGUYEN-OH - cach dua len Cloudflare Pages
1. Vao dash.cloudflare.com > Workers & Pages > Create > Pages > Upload assets.
2. Dat ten du an, keo tha file ZIP nay (hoac giai nen roi keo tha 2 file index.html va three.min.js).
3. Bam Deploy. Mo link *.pages.dev la choi duoc.
Luu y: che do Online 2 nguoi chi chay trong claude.ai. Tren Cloudflare chi choi voi may (nhac, hieu ung, 3D van day du).
